Additionally, we incorporate LLM-based metrics to evaluate aspects of article quality that traditional metrics may overlook. These include the Interest Score, Organization Score, and Focus Score, assigned by Prometheus-2 (Kim et al., 2024) using a 5-point rubric.

We employ Prometheus-2, a 7B-parameter evaluator LLM, to assess the generated articles based on three metrics: Interest Score, Organization Score, and Focus Score. For citation recall evaluation, we use gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18.
